title: doc: simplify 'Build Windows' doc
description:
This PR refactors and simplifies the 'Build' documentation for Windows.
See https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/23133 for more details

The jist of it is:
* Simplify the installation steps. Visual Studio => git/python => Qt => setup => build.
* Dependencies to build the doc were moved to a separate section
* Some images are provided to people unfamiliar with Visual Studio
* Move some sections that were misplaced (e.g. the note about Qt versioning)
* Update instructions for Visual Studio 2026 (which is much faster than 2022). I know the CI still uses 2022, but it should be available soon-ish at least on Github Runners (https://github.com/actions/runner-images/issues/13291#issuecomment-3723620715).
* To install git/python, it's unnecessary to specify that users can use chocolatey, or git extensions, etc. It makes the build instructions too verbose and hard to follow.
* Remove text that's unnecessary in a developer documentation (like explaining what 'git' is), and that generally makes the page too cluttered
